Critically, gate_helps is false on this market's history — the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown here, and the track record shows weak directional accuracy (0.375), so all leans must be treated as experimental and low-conviction.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Gold Miners (the rank-1, durability-0.91 leader) hands off to a scorable proxy — the 512400.SS (Industrial Metals) already carries a 1.302 score and would confirm the leadership handoff if it closes above Gold Miners' implied momentum for 5 consecutive sessions.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals is the only scorable, eligible theme with cross-sectional leadership AND sufficient durability (0.72) to avoid a broken trend. Its breadth (0.846) and husrt_tag 'mixed' suggest the move is broad but not yet over-extended, and crowding_z (-0.13) is neutral, meaning no reflexive crowding risk. Gold Miners leads but is unscorable (no ETF proxy), so the tradable expression of this resource leadership is Industrial Metals.
theses.dissent: The absolute-trend gate failed on this market historically (mean-reverting tape), so even a durability 0.72 trend may whipsaw; rotation breadth is narrowing (0.36 frac), suggesting the move is concentrated and fragile rather than broad-based.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS closes 5% below its level at note date within the check-by horizon

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Innovative Pharma & CXO is crowded (crowding_z 1.15, crowded=true) while showing only middling durability (0.52) and narrow breadth (0.357). Crowding is a size-down caution per guardrails, and combined with lackluster momentum rank (5th), the risk/reward of initiating or adding is poor. This is an avoid, not a fade — the theme is not a confirmed loser, just not a place to allocate fresh capital.
theses.dissent: The theme is eligible (positive absolute trend) and crowdedness by itself never justifies a fade; if breadth expands above 0.5 it could re-establish leadership.
